subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

August
solution:
The correct answer is: **Eminent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **August **means having great importance and respect in society. (समाज में बहुत महत्व और सम्मान है)
 
• Marked option **Eminent **means famous and respected within a particular sphere. (प्रख्यात)
 
• It is clear that '**August**' and '**Eminent**' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Imminent**: Likely to happen very soon. (आसन्न)
 
• **Permanent**: Lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely. (स्थायी)
 
• **Illicit**: Forbidden by law, rules, or custom. (अवैध)
